title: Material and Energy Balances
description: Serves as an introduction to the chemical engineering profession. Students are exposed to concepts used in the analysis of chemical engineering problems. Rigorous analysis of material and energy balances on open and closed systems is emphasized. An introduction to important processes in the chemical and biochemical industries is provided
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: First-year chemistry and physics or equivalent.
